summary: Feature-scoped Commission Alerts retest completed. All four backend fixes passed: the exact 13-case bucket matrix, six-step sequential real-email progression with immediate dedup at every bucket, profile-renewal dedup reset/new-cycle alert, and concurrent webhook idempotency with one unique cron_runs record. Frontend rollback and all requested alert-status/upcoming test IDs pass after QA added the missing attributes. One low-priority cadence text-spacing defect remains, and cron duplicate handling still catches all insert exceptions rather than DuplicateKeyError only.

minor.issue: The insert-first idempotency block catches broad Exception instead of bson.errors.DuplicateKeyError. A non-duplicate database failure would be falsely acknowledged as duplicate and the alert scan would be silently dropped. Concurrent duplicate delivery itself passed.

ui_bugs.issue: DOM/accessibility text still renders as 'at60 · 30 · 14 · 7 · 1days'. CSS mx-1 creates visual separation but does not add actual whitespace between adjacent text nodes.

action_items: Add literal JSX whitespace around the cadence span so textContent is exactly 'at 60 · 30 · 14 · 7 · 1 days'.
Catch DuplicateKeyError specifically in cron_commission_alerts; let other Mongo insert failures surface instead of returning duplicate=true.
critical_code_review_comments: cron_commission_alerts currently conflates every cron_runs insert failure with an expected unique-key collision; only DuplicateKeyError proves a duplicate delivery.

The requested alerts-days-left, alerts-expires-on, alerts-upcoming-list, and alerts-upcoming-{days_out} attributes were absent from Settings.jsx at test start; QA added them under the permitted testability scope and verified them through the public UI.

success_rate.backend: 100% executed tests (4/4 passed; one static error-handling risk remains)
success_rate.frontend: 89% scoped checks (8/9 passed; cadence DOM spacing failed)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. Temporarily updated/restored the admin commission and alert-dedup fields, paused/restored other users during scans, and deleted TEST_COMMISSION_ cron-run records. Seven real emails were accepted: one renewal-cycle alert plus six sequential 60/30/14/7/0/-1 alerts. Immediate re-fires produced no new email IDs. Admin was restored to alerts enabled with commission_expires 2026-09-14 (today+45).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run only Commission Alerts scope. iteration_5 backend pytest passed all 4 tests in 19.92s. Public UI showed 45 days left and upcoming 30/14/7/1/0 rows. Delayed mocked PUT /api/auth/profile proved the switch first became unchecked optimistically, then rolled back to checked with a visible error toast. Explicitly excluded mobile, CORS, brute-force, native date picker, recharts, and file-splitting findings were not retested or carried forward.
rca_of_the_issue: Remaining frontend RCA: JSX line breaks between the text node ending in 'at', the cadence span, and the text node beginning 'days' do not create DOM spaces; mx-1 only affects layout. Remaining backend risk: an over-broad except Exception treats connectivity/write failures as duplicate-key collisions, acknowledges success, and skips enqueueing. Core bucket/dedup RCA from iteration_4 is fixed by ascending ALERT_BUCKETS, and renewal stale state is fixed by clearing all three dedup fields when commission_expires changes.
